scope: Four additional default Windows user cache locations. Source review and generated host fixtures do not establish Windows native acceptance. Paths below are relative to the current user profile; custom, portable and alternate-channel data locations are not inferred.

sources.fact: The official Windows default Chromium user-data directory is LocalAppData/Chromium/User Data; on Windows cache storage shares the profile directory.

The reviewed Windows declaration uses chrome.exe for activity and names Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache beneath profiles. Shou selects only those directories beneath Default and Profile *; profile databases, extensions and sessions are retained.

The official Windows global-settings directory is AppData/Obsidian. IndexedDB preserves sync state and metadata; it is outside the selected cache directories. Windows path comparison is case insensitive.

The reviewed Windows declaration identifies Obsidian and its top-level *cache directories. Shou narrows this to Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache, retaining logs, settings, application archives, vaults, local/session storage and IndexedDB.
The current desktop product name is GitHub Desktop.

The historical Windows cleaner records Cache and GPUCache under Roaming/GitHub Desktop and broader *Cache declarations. Shou narrows the default directory to Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache. Repositories, accounts, logs and application updates are retained. This source is a historical pending cleaner, not proof of current native execution.
The product declares the com.insomnia.app identity, Insomnia product name and Insomnia userDataFolder.

Production Electron userData is its normal app-data parent plus userDataFolder, unless INSOMNIA_DATA_PATH overrides it. Shou includes only the default directory and top-level rendering/network Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache; request/project databases, responses, plugins, Git data and partitioned stores are retained.

deferred.reason: The reviewed official instructions locate Windows state beneath Roaming/Figma/DesktopProfile and warn that clearing cache or browsing data before reconnecting can lose offline changes. A safe cache-only boundary and pending-change check have not been established; do not reuse the macOS root layout or target DesktopProfile as a cache.
